text.tspan: Terraform in CI/CD: plan on every MR, apply the SAME reviewed plan on main
Merge request pipeline (plan role: read-only, via OIDC)
main pipeline (apply role: only ref=main, protected)
No static keys: GitLab id_tokens → AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity. Remote state with locking + encryption + versioning.
Pin required_version, providers, module ?ref= tags, commit .terraform.lock.hcl. Plan artifacts can hold secrets: short expiry.
Scheduled drift job: plan -detailed-exitcode (0 none · 1 error · 2 changes). Humans have read-only prod access.
